title: Sum the digits
hints: Base case: a number below 10 is a single digit, so its digit sum is the number itself.
Recursive step: the last digit is `n % 10`, and the rest of the number is `n // 10`. Add the last digit to the digit sum of the rest.
`return n % 10 + sum_digits(n // 10)`, after an `if` for the base case.

answer.explain: The reference returns `n` when `n < 10` (one digit, and this covers 0). Otherwise it returns `n % 10 + sum_digits(n // 10)`: the last digit plus the digit sum of everything before it. Each call drops one digit, so the calls reach the base case. 1234 becomes 4 + sum_digits(123), and so on.
